Gender variable: The variable gender for this data set is pretty equal, there is one row that has that variable marked as ‘unknown’. N=198 with either male or female

URM variable vs URM_AAMC : The URM variable provides higher overall representation of underrepresented in medicine students within the cohort compared to the stricter criteria, preventing small sample size limitations, maintaining adequate statistical power, and allowing for a more robust comparative evaluation.

Clinical vs Final Clerkship grades: Guth during video mention a focus on the final clerkship grades. There is a lot of missingness for some (RRC, AAC) and others have only one option heavily preferred of ‘Pass’ (ES, MSK)

USMLE scores: these don’t look like there is anything weird going on here - good!

OSCE: aggregated osce scores across competency/component (communication or physical exam - these were the ones Guth had the most interest in)
